items.prompt: She ___ from Iran.
items.explanation: With he/she/it, the verb 'be' is 'is'.
items.explanationPersian: با he/she/it فعل be به صورت is می‌آید.

items.prompt: ___ you like coffee?
items.explanation: Questions with 'you' in the present simple use 'Do'.
items.explanationPersian: سوال حال ساده با you با Do ساخته می‌شود.

items.prompt: Look! The children ___ in the garden.
items.explanation: 'Look!' signals an action happening right now — present continuous.
items.explanationPersian: Look! نشانه کاری است که همین حالا در جریان است — حال استمراری.

items.prompt: I have ___ apple and two bananas.
items.explanation: 'Apple' starts with a vowel sound, so use 'an'.
items.explanationPersian: کلمه apple با صدای صدادار شروع می‌شود، پس an درست است.

items.prompt: We go to school ___ bus.
items.explanation: For means of transport, English uses 'by': by bus, by car, by train.
items.explanationPersian: برای وسیله نقلیه از by استفاده می‌شود: by bus.

items.prompt: He ___ TV every evening.
items.explanation: With he/she/it, add -es to 'watch': watches.
items.explanationPersian: با he/she/it فعل watch به watches تبدیل می‌شود.

items.explanation: The past of 'are' is 'were'.
items.explanationPersian: گذشته are می‌شود were.

items.explanation: For a female person, the possessive adjective is 'her'.
items.explanationPersian: برای مونث صفت ملکی her است.

items.explanation: With a plural noun (two chairs), use 'there are'.
items.explanationPersian: با اسم جمع از there are استفاده می‌شود.

items.explanation: With she, 'have' becomes 'has'.
items.explanationPersian: با she فعل have به has تبدیل می‌شود.

items.explanation: Negatives in the present simple use don't/doesn't, not 'no'.
items.explanationPersian: منفی حال ساده با don't ساخته می‌شود نه با no.

items.explanation: Question word + do + subject + verb.
items.explanationPersian: کلمه پرسشی + do + فاعل + فعل.

items.prompt: I ___ to London twice.
items.explanation: 'Twice' counts experiences up to now — present perfect: have been.
items.explanationPersian: برای تجربه تا الان (twice) حال کامل به کار می‌رود.

items.prompt: This book is ___ than that one.
items.explanation: Long adjectives form the comparative with 'more'.
items.explanationPersian: صفت‌های بلند با more مقایسه می‌شوند.

items.prompt: There isn't ___ milk in the fridge.
items.explanation: 'Milk' is uncountable — use 'much' in negatives.
items.explanationPersian: milk غیرقابل‌شمارش است؛ در جمله منفی much به کار می‌رود.

items.prompt: Look at those black clouds! It ___ rain.
items.explanation: A prediction based on present evidence (the clouds) uses 'going to'.
items.explanationPersian: پیش‌بینی بر اساس شواهد حاضر با going to بیان می‌شود.

items.prompt: You ___ smoke here — it's strictly forbidden.
items.explanation: 'Forbidden' means prohibition: mustn't. ('Don't have to' = not necessary.)
items.explanationPersian: ممنوعیت با mustn't بیان می‌شود؛ don't have to یعنی لازم نیست.

items.prompt: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
items.explanation: First conditional: if + present simple, will + base verb.
items.explanationPersian: شرطی نوع اول: بعد از if حال ساده و در جمله اصلی will.

items.explanation: The superlative of 'good' is irregular: best.
items.explanationPersian: صفت عالی good بی‌قاعده است: best.

items.explanation: Present perfect: have + never + past participle.
items.explanationPersian: حال کامل: have + never + اسم مفعول.

items.after: going to visit our grandparents next weekend.
items.explanation: Going to takes the verb 'be': we are going to.
items.explanationPersian: ساختار going to با فعل be می‌آید: we are going to.

items.incorrectSentence: He can to swim very well.
items.explanation: Modal verbs take the base verb without 'to'.
items.explanationPersian: بعد از افعال مودال فعل بدون to می‌آید.

items.incorrectSentence: She has finished school last year.
items.explanation: A finished time ('last year') requires the past simple, not the present perfect.
items.explanationPersian: با زمان تمام‌شده مثل last year گذشته ساده لازم است.

items.explanation: Present perfect question: Have + subject + ever + past participle.
items.explanationPersian: سوال حال کامل: Have + فاعل + ever + اسم مفعول.

items.prompt: The letter ___ yesterday.
items.explanation: Past passive: was/were + past participle.
items.explanationPersian: مجهول گذشته: was/were + اسم مفعول.

items.prompt: The man ___ lives next door is a doctor.
items.explanation: For people as the subject of a relative clause, use 'who'.
items.explanationPersian: برای اشخاص در جمله موصولی who به کار می‌رود.

items.prompt: If I ___ rich, I would travel the world.
items.explanation: Second conditional: if + past ('were' for all persons), would + base verb.
items.explanationPersian: شرطی نوع دوم: بعد از if گذشته (were) و در جمله اصلی would.

items.prompt: I enjoy ___ in the sea.
items.explanation: 'Enjoy' is followed by the -ing form.
items.explanationPersian: بعد از enjoy فعل با ing می‌آید.

items.prompt: "I'm tired," she said. → She said she ___ tired.
items.explanation: In reported speech, the present usually shifts to the past.
items.explanationPersian: در نقل قول غیرمستقیم زمان حال به گذشته برمی‌گردد.

items.prompt: I've known him ___ ten years.
items.explanation: 'For' + a length of time; 'since' + a starting point.
items.explanationPersian: for با طول مدت و since با نقطه شروع می‌آید.

items.explanation: 'Deny' takes the -ing form: denied breaking.
items.explanationPersian: بعد از deny فعل با ing می‌آید.

items.explanation: Past passive with a singular subject: was built.
items.explanationPersian: مجهول گذشته با فاعل مفرد: was built.

items.explanation: Second conditional: 'If I were you' (informal 'was' is also heard).
items.explanationPersian: در شرطی دوم If I were you گفته می‌شود (was هم در گفتار رایج است).

items.incorrectSentence: She suggested to go to the cinema.
acceptedAnswers: She suggested going to the cinema.
items.explanation: 'Suggest' is followed by the -ing form, not 'to'.
items.explanationPersian: بعد از suggest فعل با ing می‌آید نه با to.

items.explanation: 'Information' is uncountable: no plural, singular verb.
items.explanationPersian: information غیرقابل‌شمارش است: جمع نمی‌شود و فعل مفرد می‌گیرد.

items.explanation: The relative clause 'that I bought' follows the noun it describes.
items.explanationPersian: جمله موصولی that I bought بعد از اسم می‌آید.

items.prompt: The bridge ___ by next summer.
items.explanation: Completed before a future point + passive: will have been built.
items.explanationPersian: کامل‌شده قبل از نقطه‌ای در آینده و مجهول: will have been built.

items.prompt: If she had studied harder, she ___ the exam.
items.explanation: Third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + past participle.
items.explanationPersian: شرطی سوم: if + گذشته کامل، would have + اسم مفعول.

items.prompt: ___ had I arrived when the phone rang.
items.explanation: 'Hardly had I... when...' is a fixed inverted pattern.
items.explanationPersian: Hardly had I... when... الگوی وارونه ثابت است.

items.prompt: You ___ told me — I had no idea!
items.explanation: 'Should have + past participle' criticizes a past action that didn't happen.
items.explanationPersian: should have برای سرزنش کاری که در گذشته انجام نشد به کار می‌رود.

items.prompt: He is believed ___ the country last month.
items.explanation: A past action after a reporting passive takes the perfect infinitive: to have left.
items.explanationPersian: برای عمل گذشته بعد از ساختار مجهولِ گزارشی مصدر کامل می‌آید: to have left.

items.prompt: The manager, ___ opinion I respect, disagreed with the plan.
items.explanation: 'Whose' shows possession: the manager's opinion.
items.explanationPersian: whose مالکیت را نشان می‌دهد: نظرِ مدیر.

items.after: he late, but he also forgot the documents.
items.explanation: After 'Not only' at the start, subject and verb invert: Not only was he...
items.explanationPersian: بعد از Not only در ابتدای جمله، فعل و فاعل جابه‌جا می‌شوند.

items.after: forgotten the meeting — she never misses them.
items.explanation: Deduction about the past: must have + past participle.
items.explanationPersian: حدس درباره گذشته: must have + اسم مفعول.

items.explanation: 'Would rather + person' takes a past form: I'd rather you didn't.
items.explanationPersian: بعد از would rather با فاعل دوم، فعل گذشته می‌آید.

items.incorrectSentence: If I would have known, I would have come.
acceptedAnswers: If I had known, I would have come.
Had I known, I would have come.
items.explanation: The if-clause of a third conditional takes the past perfect, never 'would have'.
items.explanationPersian: در بخش if شرطی سوم گذشته کامل می‌آید، نه would have.

items.incorrectSentence: The report needs to be finish by Friday.
acceptedAnswers: The report needs to be finished by Friday.
The report needs finishing by Friday.
items.explanation: The passive infinitive needs the past participle: to be finished.
items.explanationPersian: مصدر مجهول اسم مفعول لازم دارد: to be finished.

items.explanation: Negative adverb first forces inversion: Never have I seen...
items.explanationPersian: قید منفی در ابتدای جمله باعث وارونگی می‌شود.
